# 0. Set-up
```{r set-up}
#----------------------------------------------------------#
# Predicting outcomes after AKI using multistate models
# Code for final analyses
# Roemer J. Janse - Last updated on 2026-02-19
#----------------------------------------------------------#

# Load packages
pacman::p_load("dplyr",          # Data wrangling
               "magrittr",       # Efficient pipelines
               "tidyr",          # Data pivoting
               "stringr",        # Working with strings
               "purrr",          # Functional programming
               "here",           # Local paths
               "tableone",       # Baseline characteristics table
               "survival",       # Extract baseline hazards
               "ggplot2",        # Data visualisation
               "calibmsm",       # Calibration for multistate models
               "patchwork",      # Patching plots together
               "knitr",          # Printing to word
               "conflicted"      # Resolve function conflicts
)

# Resolve function conflicts
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::filter) # Between stats and dplyr

# Load functions
walk(list.files(here("funs")), \(x) source(paste0(here("funs"), "/", x)))

# Set path
path <- psp(unix = "/volumes/Data/lab/lab_research/RES-Folder-UPOD/NOSTRADAMUS_SALTRO/E_ResearchData/2_ResearchData/CLEANED_for_Multistate_outcomes_project/20012026/dataframes/",
            windows = "L:/lab_research/RES-Folder-UPOD/NOSTRADAMUS_SALTRO/E_ResearchData/2_ResearchData/CLEANED_for_Multistate_outcomes_project/20012026/dataframes/")

# Set path for figures
path_fig <- psp(unix = "/Users/rjanse5/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-UMCUtrecht/Documenten/Projects/202508 - Multistate AKI - Denise/figures/",
                windows = "L:/lab_research/RES-Folder-UPOD/NOSTRADAMUS_SALTRO/E_ResearchData/2_ResearchData/CLEANED_for_Multistate_outcomes_project/20012026/dataframes/")

# Load cohort data for both cohorts
loadr("outcome_derivation_em.Rdata"); loadr("outcome_derivation_tm.Rdata")

# Load covars
loadr("vec_covars.Rdata"); vec_covars <- object

# Set parameters for performance
# Last timepoint is 3651, as we cannot assess calibration on the last day of model fit in calib_msm function
timepoints <- c(1:9 * 365.25, 3651)

```

# 2. Endpoint model
```{r em set-up}
# Load predictions
loadr("predictions_fixed_em.Rdata"); dat_prds_fixed_em <- object

# Load multistate data
loadr("dat_mstate_em.Rdata"); dat_mstate <- dat_mstate_em <- object

# Load multistate fit object
loadr("mstate_fit_em.Rdata"); fit_em <- fit

# Set outcomes
outcomes_em <- c("censored", "kf", "macce", "macce_kf", "death")

# Add censoring as outcome to data
dat_spine_em_cens <- dat_spine_em %>%
  # Add variables
  mutate( # Censoring indicator
         censored = 1 - pmax(kf, macce, macce_kf, death),
         # Censoring time
         censored_tte = as.numeric(final_dt - discharge_dt))

```

## 2.1. Print model coefficients
```{r em model coefficients}
# Get coefficients
tab_coef_em <- extract_coefs(fit)

# Get baseline hazards at timepoints of interest
tab_bhaz_em <- extract_bhaz(fit, timepoints)

```

## 2.2. Model performance
### 2.2.1. PDI at every timepoint
```{r pdi em}
# Prepare data for PDI calculation
dat_pdi <- pdi_prep(dat_prds_fixed_em, timepoints, dat_spine_em_cens, outcomes_em)

# Calculate PDI for each timepoint
dat_pdis_em <- bind_rows(lapply(timepoints, \(x) pdi(dat_pdi, outcomes_em, x)))

# Change format for table
tab_pdis_em <- dat_pdis_em %>%
  # Format PDI
  mutate(pdi = format(round(pdi, 2), nsmall = 2)) %>%
  # Set to wide format
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = "time",
    values_from = "pdi"
  )

# Print table
kable(tab_pdis_em)

# Create plot for PDIs
plt_pdis_em <- plot_pdi(dat_pdis_em, outcomes_em)

# Save plot
ggsaver(plt_pdis_em, "pdis_em", 12, 8)

```

### 2.2.2. Calibration at every timepoint
```{r calibration em}
# Prepare data for calibration
lst_cal <- cal_prep(dat_spine_em, dat_prds_fixed_em, timepoints, outcomes_em)

# Get calibration data at each timepoint
dat_cal <- lapply(timepoints, \(x){
  # Run calibration
  dat_cal_timepoint <- cal(
    dat_mstate = dat_mstate,
    dat_raw = lst_cal[["dat_raw"]],
    dat_prd = lst_cal[["dat_prd"]],
    timepoint = x,
    method = "mlr",
    smoother = "loess",
    w_covs = vec_covars
  )
  
  # Return output
  return(x = dat_cal_timepoint)
})

# Get calibration plots 
plt_cal_em <- lapply(1:length(timepoints), \(x){
  # Get calibration plot
  p <- plot_cal(dat_cal[[x]][["dat_plot"]],
           outcomes_em
  )
  
  # Return plot
  return(x = p)
})

# Save calibration plots
walk(1:length(plt_cal_em), \(x) ggsaver(plt_cal_em[[x]], paste0("plt_cal_em_y", x), 6, 6))

# Extract data for CITL
dat_citl_em <- bind_rows(lapply(1:length(timepoints), \(x) extract_citl(dat_cal, x, outcomes_em)))

# Table for CITL
tab_citl_em <- dat_citl_em %>%
  # Round CITL
  mutate(citl = round(citl, 3)) %>%
  # Set to wide format
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = "time",
    values_from = "citl"
  )

# Print table
kable(tab_citl_em)

```

# 5. Example patients
## 5.1. Selection of two patients
```{r}
# Select two people
vec_ids_exm <- dat_spine_em[["id"]][c(20, 131)]

# Subset data
dat_exm <- filter(dat_spine_em, id %in% vec_ids_exm)                       # Subset spine data for descriptive table
dat_prds_exm_em_a <- filter(dat_prds_fixed_em, id %in% vec_ids_exm[[1]])   # Subset endpoint model predictions for A
dat_prds_exm_tm_a <- filter(dat_prds_fixed_tm, id %in% vec_ids_exm[[1]])   # Subset endpoint + CKD model predictions for A
dat_prds_exm_em_b <- filter(dat_prds_fixed_em, id %in% vec_ids_exm[[2]])   # Subset endpoint model predictions for A
dat_prds_exm_tm_b <- filter(dat_prds_fixed_tm, id %in% vec_ids_exm[[2]])   # Subset endpoint + CKD model predictions for A

```

## 5.2. Descriptive table
```{r}
# Add stratifier to baseline data of example patients
dat_exm %<>% mutate(pat = if_else(row_number() == 1, "A", "B"))

# List of variables that are also predictors
vec_var <- c(# Demographics
             "age", "female", 
             # Index AKI
             "stage", 
             # Hospitalisation characteristics
             "los", "ihe_cts", "ihe_ncts", 
             # Comorbidities
             "com_arr", "com_cad", "com_cbvd", "com_copd", "com_diab", "com_hf", "com_hyp", "com_mal", 
             # Medication
             "med_ims", "med_lla", "med_ntd")

# Continuous variables
vec_cnt <- c("age", "los", "stage")

# Categorical variables
vec_cat <- vec_var[!(vec_var %in% vec_cnt)]

# Create table
(tab_exm <- CreateTableOne(vec_var,
                           data = dat_exm,
                           factorVars = vec_cat,
                           strata = "pat") %>%
  # Print table to matrix
  print(printToggle = FALSE,
        contDigits = 1,
        noSpaces = TRUE) %>%
  # Set class to data frame
  as.data.frame() %>%
  # Drop test columns
  select(-c(p, test)) %>%
  # Change values
  mutate(# Get row name as variable
         rowname = rownames(.),
         # Drop decimals and incalculable measures of spread
         across(A:B, \(x) str_replace(x, "\\.0 \\(NA\\)", "")),
         # Set dichotomous variables to yes/no
         across(A:B, \(x) case_when(str_detect(rowname, "= 1 \\(%\\)") & str_detect(x, "1 \\(") ~ "Yes", 
                                    str_detect(rowname, "= 1 \\(%\\)") & str_detect(x, "0 \\(") ~ "No",
                                    .default = x)),
         across(A:B, \(x) case_when(str_detect(rowname, "= 0 \\(%\\)") & str_detect(x, "1 \\(") ~ "No", 
                                    str_detect(rowname, "= 0 \\(%\\)") & str_detect(x, "0 \\(") ~ "Yes",
                                    .default = x)),
         # Set sex to female/male
         across(A:B, \(x) case_when(str_detect(rowname, "female") & str_detect(x, "Yes") ~ "Female", 
                                    str_detect(rowname, "female") & str_detect(x, "No") ~ "Male",
                                    .default = x))) %>%
  # Set row names
  set_rownames(c("Number of individuals",
                 "Age, yrs",
                 "Sex",
                 "AKI stage, n (%)",
                 "Hospital length of stay, days",
                 "Cardiothoracic surgery",
                 "Non-cardiothoracic surgery",
                 "Arrhythmias",
                 "Coronary artery disease",
                 "Cerebrovascular disease",
                 "COPD",
                 "Diabetes mellitus",
                 "Heart failure",
                 "Hypertension",
                 "Malignancy",
                 "Immunosuppresives",
                 "Lipid-lowering agents",
                 "Nephrotoxic drugs")) %>%
  # Drop first row
  filter(rowname != "n") %>%
  # Drop rownames
  select(-rowname) %>%
  # Set columnnames
  set_colnames(c("Individual A", "Individual B"))) %>%
  # Print as table
  kable()


# Write to .xlsx
writexl::write_xlsx(tab_exm %>% mutate(var = rownames(.)), path = paste0(path, "tab_exm.xlsx"))

```

## 5.4. Example calculations
### 5.4.1. Ensure data anonymity
```{r}
# Create aggregate dat_mstate object
dat_mstate %<>%
  # Arrange for grouping
  arrange(id) %>%
  # Group per person
  group_by(id) %>%
  # Create ID based on group index
  mutate(id = cur_group_id()) %>%
  # Remove grouping structure
  ungroup() %>%
  # Aggregate other information
  mutate(
    # Continuous variables
    across(
      all_of(setdiff(colnames(dat_mstate)[sapply(colnames(dat_mstate), \(x) n_distinct(dat_mstate[[x]]) > 3)], 
                     c("id", "from", "to", "trans", "Tstart", "Tstop", "time"))), mean
    ),
    # Non-continuous variables
    across(
      all_of(setdiff(colnames(dat_mstate)[sapply(colnames(dat_mstate), \(x) n_distinct(dat_mstate[[x]]) < 3)], 
                     c("id", "status"))), min
    ),
  )

# Introduce noise into coefficients and linear predictors to prevent back-calculation
# Seed for random process
set.seed(1)

# Jitter coefficients
fit[["coefficients"]] <- jitter(fit[["coefficients"]], factor = 0.001)

# Jitter linear predictors
fit[["linear.predictors"]] <- jitter(fit[["linear.predictors"]], factor = 0.001)

# Get predictions from model to check with new dat_mstate object
dat_prds_exm <- prd_mstate(dat_exm, vec_covars, mat_trans)

# Check with real predictions: 4 decimals is sufficient precision
table(round(dat_prds_exm_em_a, 3) == round(filter(dat_prds_exm, id == vec_ids_exm[[1]]), 3))
table(round(dat_prds_exm_em_b, 3) == round(filter(dat_prds_exm, id == vec_ids_exm[[2]]), 3))

# Check FALSE's
dat_prds_exm_em_a[!(round(dat_prds_exm_em_a, 3) == round(filter(dat_prds_exm, id == vec_ids_exm[[1]]), 3))]
filter(dat_prds_exm, id == vec_ids_exm[[1]])[!(round(dat_prds_exm_em_a, 3) == round(filter(dat_prds_exm, id == vec_ids_exm[[1]]), 3))]

# Unique transition combinations
dat_mstate %>%
  # Drop ID 
  select(-id) %>%
  # Group by all variables
  group_by_all() %>%
  # Count unique rows
  count() %>%
  # Keep one row per group
  slice(1L) %>%
  # Drop grouping structure
  ungroup() %>%
  # Keep only varying variables
  select(from:status, n)

```

## 5.6. Two hypothetical patients for manuscript
### 5.6.1. Endpoint model
```{r}
# Transition matrix
mat_trans <- structure(c(NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, 1L, NA, NA, NA, 
                         NA, 2L, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, 4L, 6L, 
                         NA, NA, 3L, 5L, 7L, 8L, NA), 
                       dim = c(5L, 5L), 
                       dimnames = 
                         list(from = c("Baseline", "KF", "MACCE", 
                                       "MACCE_KF", "Death"), 
                              to = c("Baseline", "KF", "MACCE", 
                                     "MACCE_KF", "Death")))

# Model fit
fit <- fit_em

# mstate data
dat_mstate <- dat_mstate_em

# Set-up data for individual
dat_predictors <- dat_prep(age = c(61, 73),
                           female = 1:0,
                           aki_stage = 2:1,
                           los = c(17, 24),
                           arrhythmia = 0,
                           cad = 1:0,
                           cbvd = 0,
                           copd = 0,
                           diabetes = 1,
                           heartfailure = 0:1,
                           hypertension = 1,
                           malignancy = 0,
                           immunosuppresives = 0,
                           lipidloweringagents = 1,
                           nephrotoxicdrugs = 1:0,
                           cardiothoracicsurg = 1,
                           noncardiothoracicsurg = 0)

# Calculate predictions
dat_exm_em <- prd_mstate(dat_predictors, vec_predictors, mat_trans)

```

### 5.6.2. Transition model
```{r}
# Transition matrix
mat_trans <- structure(c(NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, 1L, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, 
                         NA, NA, 4L, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, 2L, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, 
                         5L, NA, 9L, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, 7L, NA, 11L, NA, NA, 3L, 6L, 
                         8L, 10L, 12L, 13L, NA), 
                       dim = c(7L, 7L), 
                       dimnames = list(from = c("Baseline", "CKD", "KF", "MACCE", "MACCE_CKD", "MACCE_KF", "Death"), 
                                       to = c("Baseline", "CKD", "KF", "MACCE", "MACCE_CKD", "MACCE_KF", "Death")))

# Model fit
fit <- fit_tm

# mstate data
dat_mstate <- dat_mstate_tm

# Set-up data for individual
dat_predictors <- dat_prep(age = c(61, 73),
                           female = 1:0,
                           aki_stage = 2:1,
                           los = c(17, 24),
                           arrhythmia = 0,
                           cad = 1:0,
                           cbvd = 0,
                           copd = 0,
                           diabetes = 1,
                           heartfailure = 0:1,
                           hypertension = 1,
                           malignancy = 0,
                           immunosuppresives = 0,
                           lipidloweringagents = 1,
                           nephrotoxicdrugs = 1:0,
                           cardiothoracicsurg = 1,
                           noncardiothoracicsurg = 0)

# Calculate predictions
dat_exm_tm <- prd_mstate(dat_predictors, vec_predictors, mat_trans)

```

### 5.6.3. Create plots
```{r}
# Create plots
lst_exm <- list(plot_rsk(filter(dat_exm_em, id == 1), outcomes_em, timepoints, verbose_legend = TRUE),
                plot_rsk(filter(dat_exm_em, id == 2), outcomes_em, timepoints, verbose_legend = TRUE),
                plot_rsk(filter(dat_exm_tm, id == 1), outcomes_tm, timepoints),
                plot_rsk(filter(dat_exm_tm, id == 2), outcomes_tm, timepoints))

# Wrap plots
plt_exm <- wrap_plots(lst_exm,
                      guides = "collect") +
  # Annotations
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = lst(c("A.1", "B.1", "A.2", "B.2"))) &
  # Relocate legend
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# Save figure
ggsaver(plt_exm, "hypothetical_example", 8, 8)

```
